description: Managed VS Code Chat/Agent defaults. sync-vscode-agent-defaults.py merges these keys into the machine-local VS Code Copilot CLI agent-host config and the local VS Code user settings.json, so a fresh VS Code Chat/Agents-window session always starts fully autonomous (Bypass Approvals + Autopilot) and token-lean (built-in GitHub MCP off, cross-app MCP discovery off, no stale default agent). keysRemove entries are deleted from the target file when present. This is a distinct surface from config/copilot-settings.json, which manages the standalone terminal `copilot` CLI (~/.copilot/*) rather than VS Code's own Chat/Agent extension.
